title: PXAPI stage execution record v1
description: A snapshot of one processing stage's current execution within an Analysis Run — not an attempt history. It exists because Pass 1 runs Baseline Collection and Business Research concurrently (Confluence 39846055 §8) and one top-level run state cannot describe two activities; pxapi.domain.stage_execution projects the Pass-1 records onto the run state vocabulary. A record is written when a stage starts; stages that have not started need no record. CANCELLED is only ever the consequence of a concurrent sibling stage failing.

run_id.description: Required. The Analysis Run this stage execution belongs to.

stage.description: Required. Which processing activity this record describes.

status.description: Required. The stage's current execution status.

started_at.description: Required, nullable. When execution started; null if and only if status is PENDING.

finished_at.description: Required, nullable. When execution ended; non-null if and only if status is SUCCEEDED, FAILED or CANCELLED.

failure.description: Conditional. Present if and only if status is FAILED: the sanitised failure code and detail.

output_artifact_refs.description: Required. The artifacts this stage execution produced so far. An empty array means none were produced (yet); it never means anything about the website.
